_note: House answers for the video menu, and the menu's own words. A new video starts with these values, marked from: defaults, until each is confirmed. Items 1 (job) and 2 (sources) are each video's own. Change a value here with its reason and every new video picks it up. title, ask, options and fields are what vkit menu shows; options_from names the data folder that fills an option list (looks, brands, patterns, apps), so nobody types a list into a skill.

job.title: The job

options.means: a task in a recreated screen, start to finish
an idea explained with words and drawings, no screen
a concept opener, then the screen, then a recap (the starter)

length.free: a target in seconds or minutes, under five minutes (rules.json pacing)

audience.free: who watches and what they already know

job.reason: Each video's own. The kind decides which patterns are offered first.

sources.title: The sources
sources.ask: Where does the screen come from?

options.means: whiteboard or theory: no screen at all
a one-off screen built in the video from a couple of captures, as the starter does
a recreated app: vkit new --app family/tool copies its states in; vkit app extract lifts an inline screen into one the day it is needed twice

app.free: family/tool of a recreated app in $VKIT_APPS, ../apps or examples/apps

ids.free: the element ids the timeline points at

missing.free: controls the captures do not show; a screen with no capture is a concept scene

sources.reason: Recreate from your own captures, cite each, never invent a control.

layout.title: The layout
layout.ask: How does the screen sit in the frame?

options.means: the screen at native pixels fills the frame; text is large; the explanation card sits beside its element

layout.reason: The screen at native pixels fills the frame; text is large; the explanation is a card beside its element. The review of earlier work found text slides read as empty and an inset screen as three quarters of the frame. The classic inset layout with a rail is not built; the rail and caption band rows in rules.json are marked not applicable.

brand.title: The brand

options.means: no brand: the look and the theme defaults render

brand.reason: No brand until one is applied through vkit brand; the theme defaults render. Choosing one here runs vkit brand <name>.

look.title: The look

options.means: modern whiteboard, marker on charcoal: the theme's own defaults

look.reason: Modern whiteboard, marker on charcoal. The studied looks are offered from looks/. Choosing one here runs vkit look <name>. Locked once the clips are measured: a look changes entrance and crossfade times.

tone.title: The tone

options.means: one accent, no grain, cuts rather than glides, longer holds allowed (12 s); capability stays, restraint is a setting
the look's whole range: glides, grain where the look has it, holds under 8 s

tone.reason: One accent, no grain, cuts rather than glides, longer holds. Capability stays; restraint is a setting. vkit check reads the tone for the still-run limit (rules.json motion.maxStillSeconds). Locked once the clips are measured.

patterns.title: The patterns
patterns.ask: Which measured moves does this video lean on?
patterns.reason: The measured moves closest to a walkthrough and a definitions opener. The 35 come from patterns/index.json with the phrase a person would say. Locked once the clips are measured: a pattern sets where the cuts fall.

voice.title: The voice
voice.ask: How does the narration get made, and what goes beside it?

options.means: one clip per part in voice/, measured by vkit measure; the clips are the clock
no narration track: the MP4 is silent and the PARTS line stays an estimate
a VTT and an SRT beside the MP4, from storyboard.md
no caption files
no bed, so a pause stays available; a bed is not built

voice.reason: Clips per part, measured, are the clock; captions as a file; no bed so a pause stays available. Locked once the clips are measured.

characters.title: The cast

options.means: no figures; who() in the timeline is the author's call either way
a figure may point, look and wait beside the thing being explained

characters.reason: Off when the tone is formal.

fixed_lines.title: The fixed lines
fixed_lines.ask: Where does the series card go?

options.means: a series card after the opening hook
a series card first; delays the reason to watch
no series card

fixed_lines.reason: A series card after the opening hook; one before it delays the reason to watch.
